, Reason for Mistake: Adopted flawed scraping logic that grabbed all linked names from tables containing a “Winner” header (not just the actual winner cells), yielding an impossible count of 67 unique Survivor winners—greater than the 44 seasons—and treated it as accurate. This erroneous Survivor count propagated into the final calculation, leading to the wrong answer.
